verdict.rationale: The vendor documents a self-serve dev instance (up to 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM) with "No credit card required" [obsessiondb-docs-10]. It also documents a signup-to-first-query flow of about five minutes (create a cluster, connect any ClickHouse client, load your own data, query) with no sales step [obsessiondb-docs-6]. Pricing can be computed before talking to sales [obsessiondb-docs-27]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the free dev instance works as described, and documented limits on storage, data volume, and how long the free instance lasts.
